name: n8n Failed Execution Doctor
description: Diagnose exported failed n8n execution data locally, identify the failing node, classify common root causes such as 401/403, 429, timeouts, network, invalid input, and expression errors, and return a focused next diagnostic step. No external API key or LLM required.

setup: "When Executed by Another Workflow" (executeWorkflowTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

hints: The original was a sub-workflow called by another workflow; pass its inputs as run inputs.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
